about.name: Ari Shojaei
about.bio: Born in 1995, I moved to another country to seek new adventures and opportunities. I started photography as a hobby and a way to communicate with new people. Along the way, I made many close friends because of this hobby, and as I go further, photography becomes more and more important. Now, I think big about my future in this field.
